avis.titre: In just 2 weeks post acne marks have faded
avis.texte: In just 2 weeks I've seen my post acne marks fade so much. They are not completely gone but are so much improved. As a woman of color I've always struggled with hyperpigmentation, especially after a breakout. I've tried so many different brands of tranexamic acid and vitamin C and the ones from farmacy are the ones that I've seen the most improvement. I've been using the TXA in combination with the 10% Waterless Vitamin C serum and Honey Halo Moisturizer. Some days I don't apply Viatmain C but I always apply the TXA. Always wearing sunscreen in the AM. I've added an image so you can see why I'm so impressed. The left side are the before and right are the after. Also please note that I'm always outside, as I work in daycare in Texas. The sun makes hyperpigmentation more prevalent, so this product has become so important to my routine. I can't wait to see the results after a full month!
